title: Linear proof function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a Boolean table indexed by the disjoint union of sets of sizes $2^n$ and $2^{n^2}$. The associated function on the binary cube of dimension $n$ evaluates $P$ at the index of its input in the first summand, then interprets the resulting Boolean value as an element of the field with two elements.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a Boolean table indexed by a set of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$
